_: Showcase: the 6 big tiles at the top of README.md, README.ko.md and docs/index.html (tools/make-readme-gallery.mjs, tools/make-docs.mjs). A tile with "placeholder" stands in for its slot until that graphic is in the catalog. "scenes": graphics that fill a frame with nobody in it, listed under Whole-frame scenes.

showcase.name: body-palm-hologram
showcase.en: A 3D object spins over your raised hand, a beam runs from your palm.
showcase.ko: 든 손 위에서 3D 물체가 돌고, 손바닥에서 빛줄기가 뻗습니다.

showcase.name: body-behind-text
showcase.en: Big words stand behind you. You stay in front.
showcase.ko: 큰 글자가 사람 뒤에 섭니다. 사람은 앞에 그대로.

showcase.name: body-contour-line
showcase.en: A glowing line follows your outline while you move.
showcase.ko: 빛나는 선이 움직이는 내 윤곽을 따라갑니다.

showcase.name: body-hand-buddy
showcase.en: A little robot rides on your hand and follows it.
showcase.ko: 작은 로봇이 손 위에 올라타 손을 따라다닙니다.

showcase.name: remotion-noise-flow-field
showcase.en: Lines flow through a noise field and the word rises out of them.
showcase.ko: 노이즈 흐름을 따라 선이 흐르고, 그 사이로 낱말이 떠오릅니다.

showcase.name: remotion-shapes-agents
showcase.en: Robots drawn in code pass the ball, in a scene with nobody in it.
showcase.ko: 코드로 그린 로봇들이 공을 주고받는, 사람 없는 장면.
